probe.method: Each video loaded muted in the public YouTube embedded player; no API key. Refusals confirmed by an isolated recheck beside a playing control video.

args.note: First batch probe. Its first 759 results were kept; everything after YouTube began throttling (refusals and timeouts on almost every video) was discarded. R8kc1_Nusrs and zXVoG3z8CMo also refused in a separate single-player check minutes later, without a control in the same session, so all refusals remain suspected until an isolated recheck.
